# P37.25 — Overview builder B (K2 GX-08b)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/449_P37.25__overview-builder-b.md` (row 449, `R11-K13-GX-08b`)
**Base:** `r11/P37.24-overview-builder-a` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent

## What lands

- `exports/src/exports/graph_overview.py` — the `sig.graph-overview/1` builder
  completes the 08b catalogue: **O2 `access`** ("Who can search whose data?" —
  §12.2 access-kind edges: configured / observed / declared-policy, the
  `configured_sharing_partner` share-list claims + the historical Data Driven
  form), **O5 `governance`** (bill/policy/event subjects → jurisdiction,
  technology and enacting/oversight bodies), **O7 `adoption`** (agency/atlas
  subjects → technology, `uses_*` predicate fallback). Past `MATRIX_MIN` (200)
  endpoints the foldable side collapses to admin-1 place cells — the state ×
  state / state × technology weighted matrix of K2 §5.2 (SIG-UI-021); folded
  edges carry `member_count` (distinct folded members), `cap_actions` record
  the fold — declared aggregation, never a smoothed cut. Folded overviews emit
  per-place slice docs (`web/graph/<ov>/places/<comp>.<jkey>.json`, same
  schema, `slice` marked) = the unfolded subgraph the drill-down renders.
  `sig.graph-components/1` index + `sig.graph-component/1` member files per
  compartment (K2 §6.4, SIG-EXPORT-D20), components ≤ 3,000 members.
- **Compartments (S6R-12 / SIG-LIC-009a):** share-list edges file under the
  CC-BY-SA `portal` compartment by the same claim-intersection rule every
  other edge uses — never blended; SIG-LIC-010's computed-licence build check
  is unchanged (the per-artifact `web_licenses` stamp already computes it).
- `web/`: `memberCount` + `slice` decode, `slices` index rows, the drill-down
  prefers slice docs, `getComponentsIndex`, the 08b fixture corpus (access on
  the `portal` compartment), T1 unchanged — no `<script>`, no budget change.
- Tests: pytest 20 legs (access kind relations, degree/set never an edge,
  matrix fold + weighted cells + slices, node-link under threshold,
  governance, adoption fallback, components index/member files/withheld);
  vitest 8 (matrix + memberCount + slice decode, components index); e2e 6
  (hub 7 rows, matrix fold note + member cell, slice egos, downloads, JS-off).
